title: TechDocs qrels record
description: One graded relevance judgement for a retrieval query against a stable document/section. qrels must reference stable document_id/section_path only; volatile chunk/page/element ordinals and answer text are rejected. Language is zh or en; reviewer_hash is a redacted reviewer identifier.

reviewer_hash.description: Redacted reviewer identifier (16 hex chars). Empty string means the row is not yet reviewed.

review_status.description: Review status — UNREVIEWED (no review), AI_REVIEWED (Sol dual-pass confirmed), DISPUTED (disagreement/low confidence), HUMAN_REVIEWED (human verified).

reviewer_model.description: Actual model used for review (e.g. gpt-5.6-sol).

review_prompt_hash.description: sha256 hex of the rendered prompt, truncated to 16 chars.

review_pass.description: Which independent review pass produced this row (sidecar files only).

review_confidence.description: Reviewer confidence (0.0-1.0). AI_REVIEWED requires min(A,B) >= threshold.

review_evidence.description: Corpus evidence reference string for this review (e.g. es:index:document_id:source_path).

verdicts.description: Per-pass verdict dimensions (answerable, language_correct, query_type_correct, relevance_correct, section_correct, evidence_sufficient, contamination_risk, confidence).
